resolved.title: if 语句
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Decision Making[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]if statement[/b] can be used to make decisions and run code when a given condition is [b]true[/b].

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" codeId="3312"]x := 42

 if x > 18 {
  fmt.Println("Allowed")
}[/code]
The code of the [b]if[/b] statement should be enclosed in curly braces { } and can include multiple lines of code.
[note]The code in the curly braces of an [b]if[/b] statement will run only if the condition evaluates to [b]true[/b].[/note]

resolved.title: If 语句声明变量

content.text:
有时你只需要在**if-else**语句中使用一个变量。

content.text_html:
Sometimes you need a variable only for the if/else statements. For this, the if statement in Go can start with a variable declaration before the condition:

有时你只需要在if/else语句中使用一个变量。 为此，Go中的if语句可以在条件之前先声明一个变量。

content.text: 注意变量声明后面的分号`;` -- 用来分隔语句的。
content.text_html:
Note the semicolon after the variable declaration - it is used to separate the statements.

注意变量声明后面的分号--它是用来分隔语句的。

content.text: 在**if**语句中声明的变量只在**if-else**块中可见。

resolved.title: 体温检测
resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设你正在为一个机场的体温检测系统编写程序。
该系统测量一个人的体温，如果体温在正常范围内，需要输出 "**Allowed**"，如果体温高于正常范围，则输出 "**Fever**"。

- 正常体温： 小于等于 99.5 °F
- 发烧体温： 大于 99.5 °F

程序应将温度作为**float**类型输入，请输出期望的信息。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Temperature Checker[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are writing a program for a temperature checking system at an airport.
The system measures the body temperature of a person and needs to output "[b]Allowed[/b]" if it is in the normal range, or "[b]Fever[/b]" if it is higher than normal.
[b]Normal[/b]: up to 99.5 °F 
[b]Fever[/b]: > 99.5 °F

The program should take the temperature as a [b]float[/b] from input and output the corresponding message.
[b]Sample Input:[/b]
101.3

[b]Sample Output:[/b]
Fever

[note]Use an [b]if/else[/b] statement to make the decision.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 使用**if-else**语句来做条件判断。
